rationale: A 4h Donchian channel breakout was tested because BTC can exhibit medium-timeframe momentum from reflexive dynamics, institutional flow, leverage cascades, and information diffusion. The Donchian channel offers a simple trend-following rule that enters when price breaks to new highs or lows over a pre-registered lookback. RETROSPECTIVE: this plan was authored after execution as part of WP-6c to extend the schema grammar to the remaining concluded candidates. The original H-002 pre-registration lives in research/hypotheses/H-002/HYPOTHESIS.md and was not schema-validated at the time.
hypothesis_to_test: A Donchian channel breakout strategy on BTCUSDT perpetual 4h bars will generate OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of fees, capture both bullish and bearish trend regimes, exhibit positive skewness, and survive walk-forward validation with efficiency > 0.5.

additional_criteria: OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs
Gate 2 passes under current evaluator semantics: dsr_val > 0.95 versus the expected maximum-SR benchmark from the registered trial count
Max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold
Parameter sensitivity: +/-25% parameter shift keeps Sharpe within 70% of baseline
No single 90-day window contributes > 60% of total PnL
Kill criteria from H-002 HYPOTHESIS.md apply: OOS Sharpe < 0.3, max drawdown > 35%, no profitable year in OOS, or weak win/loss profile

data_requirements: BTCUSDT funding rates full history supplied for funding cashflows: data/processed/binance_um_perp_BTCUSDT_funding_8h_2019-09-10_2026-04-12_2026-04-12T1655Z.parquet
Optional 1d OHLCV confirmation was documented for a later variant and was not part of the baseline
No separate IS/OOS split convention existed in repo truth for this baseline; DEC-0002 records full-period Sharpe in both trial-log Sharpe fields
